searchLimit.title: Search result limit
searchLimit.description: Number of icons fetched from Iconify per request, default 60

defaultColor.title: Default icon color
defaultColor.description: Default color baked into the saved SVG. SiYuan renders custom icons as , so they cannot follow the theme color.

iconGroup.title: Custom icon group
iconGroup.description: Folder name under data/emojis where icons are stored, default iconify-set

searchDebounce.title: Search debounce
searchDebounce.description: Debounce delay for the search input in milliseconds, default 300, minimum 200

batchConcurrency.title: Batch concurrency
batchConcurrency.description: Concurrent requests when applying icons in batch / auto matching, default 3

autoIconNewDoc.title: Auto icon for newly opened docs
autoIconNewDoc.description: Automatically search and set an icon by title when opening a document without icon (disabled by default, may cause many network requests)

enabledCollections.title: Icon sets in use
enabledCollections.description: Pick the Iconify icon sets you prefer. Search will only look in these sets. A few common colorful sets are selected by default. Nothing selected means all icon sets are used.

resetSettings.title: Reset settings
resetSettings.description: Restore all options to their default values. A confirmation dialog will be shown first
